items.title: US will not resume strikes on Iran before midterms — Trump
items.description: President Donald Trump said the US will not resume strikes on Iran before the midterm elections on November 3. High gas and grocery prices are top concerns for voters.

items.title: France: Police clash with protesters at Paris student rally
items.description: Police fired tear gas at protesters in Paris again as students continue to voice grievances about school conditions across France. The education minister has said 3,000 substitute teachers will reach schools soon.

items.title: Ukraine, Europe, US to meet in Miami for talks on ending war
items.description: Officials from Ukraine, Europe and the US are meeting in Miami to discuss ways to break the deadlock in the war. The meeting comes as Russian strikes on Ukraine killed more than 70 people this week.

items.title: Security in the Black Sea region: is Bulgaria the weak link in Europe's defense against threats from Russia?
items.description: Two ships have sunk off the coast of Bulgaria and Romania after drone attacks in recent days. Bulgaria has held back on pointing the finger at Russia. What does that mean for security in the Black Sea and the region?
